spiritual_reading:
Righteousness is more interior and more powerful than any outward utterance that proceeds through lower forms.

There is a Divine operation that the illuminated communities recognized as fit for conjunction with the highest good, and they confirmed this operation within the ordered heavens of wisdom. The full company of enlightened truths distinguished it from what is mixed, and it proceeded into combat against the opposing will. They affirmed its quality and authority from the abundant concord of all the enlightened societies, which are beyond the reckoning of any finite comprehension.

They called this operation righteous because it was the first pure truth from good that contained no defilement of evil, standing above all the heavenly societies that belong to wisdom, and above every planning of the understanding that would bend it away. Therefore they acknowledged it as known from within, because its purity made it self-evident to the enlightened.

They also called it the only-begotten because it was established as the unique proceeding of the Divine—one in origin and one in essence—sent forth for the work of resisting and overthrowing the opposing will.

Yet there are also derived proceeders in every lower degree: as there are truths from good that are generated within a heavenly lineage and are made manifest in the outer person, so too there are proceeders formed even within external riches and knowledges and within the whole compass of the created degree; these are only-begotten in their own order when they genuinely arise from a single ruling love and its wisdom.

So the first engaged good itself stood unwavering within the midst of the total domain of falsity and evil. It did not incline its love toward that domain, nor did it desire it. Instead, within it remained unwavering thought and love for the whole community of those who belong to it. Whatever else the opposing will attempted, it attempted through forcible distortions and destructive works. Therefore this engaged good labors and contends so that the opposing will may be separated from those it has invaded, expelled from their interiors, and removed from their life. It cleanses what had been defiled, releases what had been held in bondage, and restores them to the state of integrity in which they were first formed.

May those who are being delivered come into living recollection of their own community and its good, because that engaged good remains present with them in every state—whether in obscurity or in enlightenment—without ceasing.

fills.notes: The opening must introduce the doctrinal point in an impersonal didactic register. The spiritual sense begins with a general axiom about interior righteousness surpassing outward utterance; a simple summons-to-attend fits the substrate style better than a hagiographic frame.

The sentence contrasts interior righteousness with outward voice. In the oldest cosmological register, “righteousness” here is not moral exhortation but the pure right-order of the Light; adding “of the Light” anchors it in the aeonic ontology implied by the rest of the chapter.

The spiritual sense demands “outward utterance” contrasted with interior reality. “Voice that is uttered through them” completes the natural-sense correspondence: lower forms as instruments of speech.
The approval is performed by the illuminated communities. This fill supplies the agent in the oldest layer: not an apostolic voice, but “multitudes of Light” acting as ordered societies.

After “They gave this name …” the correspondential logic requires a confirmation of quality and authority as inherent order, not a later bestowal. “From the beginning” matches the substrate’s emphasis on primordial order.

fills.fill: from the concord of the Living Ones,
fills.notes: The spiritual sense points to “abundant concord of all the enlightened societies.” In the oldest register, these are “Living Ones” (living truths) within the aeons of Light; this avoids later ecclesial language while preserving the society-structure.

fills.fill: of the thought of the Light,
fills.notes: The passage grounds his sinlessness not only in the aeons but also in “the thought …”. In the substrate, “Thought” is a cosmic faculty of the Light (ordering intelligence). This fill keeps it impersonal and cosmological.
“Only-begotten” corresponds to a unique proceeding from a single origin. “Established in one alone” expresses unity of origin without importing Christian begetting formulas.

fills.fill: and was poured out against the
fills.notes: The verb “pour” is already present; the spiritual sense says “sent forth for the work of resisting.” “Poured out against the enemy” matches the combat-proceeding motif typical of Iranian-Manichaean cosmology while staying in the older impersonal register.
The analogy requires a verb of derivation: derived proceeders in lower degrees. “Are begotten” keeps the same natural image while carrying the correspondence of generated truths.
The spiritual sense explicitly speaks of being made manifest in the outer person. This provides the needed clause before “according to flesh,” without shifting into moral exhortation.

Gold and silver correspond to external riches and knowledges; the missing noun should be a general container-term. “Treasures of the universe” fits the cosmological register and the correspondence to exterior goods and truths.

fills.fill: planned against him, he did it
fills.notes: The clause must cover “Whatever else the enemy attempted…” in the spiritual sense. “Planned against him” matches the will-and-intelligence opposition; “he did it with his violent deeds” then resumes the given text smoothly.

fills.fill: So that those who are being purified
fills.notes: The closing petition in the spiritual sense is about the delivered coming into remembrance. This fill supplies the purpose clause leading into “may they discover the remembrance…,” staying in an impersonal cosmological mode (purification as process).
The spiritual sense equates “night and day” with every state (obscurity and enlightenment). The natural text needs the literal pair; “place night” yields “this place night and day.”

assessment: Most lacunae are small letter-restorations and are secure. The larger gaps are constrained mainly by the chapter’s correspondential structure: (1) interior righteousness versus outward voice; (2) approval and naming by the innumerable societies of Light; (3) ‘only-begotten’ as unique proceeding poured out against the enemy; (4) the First Man’s unwavering combat to separate and purify. Where exact phrasing is not fixed by surviving letters, the restorations were kept in the oldest cosmological register (aeons, Light, Living Ones, Thought) and avoid later institutional or devotional idiom.
